eps.ov: The Demon King, Rchimedes, has been revived and Hero and Royal Solider are out there to level up.
eps.oa: عاد ملك الشياطين «روكيميديس» إلى الحياة، وانطلق البطل «ألبا» وجندي القصر «روس» ليرفعا مستواهما.

eps.ov: The Hero has to level up and does it in the worst way…
eps.oa: على البطل أن يرفع مستواه، فيفعل ذلك بأسوأ طريقة...

eps.ov: The Demon King is out to destroy the world! Right?
eps.oa: ملك الشياطين عازم على تدمير العالم! أليس كذلك؟

eps.ov: A new hero by the name of Foyfoy will stop the Demon King!
Everybody has their reasons for stopping the Demon King, some not as honorable as others.
Rudolf volunteers to tell the king the true nature of the Demon king but that doesn’t end very well.
Locked up, there is nothing the party can do but share stories. And Rchi shares the story of the 12 demons.
Janua shows off his skill in Ninjutsu.

eps.t: The Hero is at a Loss
eps.ov: Janua has a simple request for the Hero.
Even after saying his goodbyes, the witch, Februar Zwei will not let Janua leave as he is one of the chosen.
The inmates have time for dodge ball while Hime deals with her Hero.
With so many Heroes gathering around, thing’s still aren’t getting done.
